description: The documentation deliverables: API documentation for every endpoint, an append-only setup/run/API section on README.md (preserving the original assignment text), and the REQUIRED, heavily-weighted DECISIONS.md. Depends on FEAT-002/003 so the docs describe the actually-implemented behavior and the real test strategy. Grounded in design.md Sections 10, 11, 15, 16, 17 and the README 'Required Deliverables' + 'DECISIONS.md' sections. Folds in F3 (document the fingerprint immutable-cart assumption) and F4 (document where reservedBy / a txn id reappears in the multi-instance DB version).
steps: Create c:\...\be\API.md documenting every endpoint from design Section 10 (GET /products, GET /products/:id, POST /carts, GET /carts/:id, POST/PATCH/DELETE cart items, POST /carts/:id/checkout with Idempotency-Key header + optional couponCode, GET /orders/:id, POST /admin/coupons/generate, GET /admin/coupons, GET /admin/report): for each give method, path, request (headers/params/body), success response + status, and important error cases with their stable codes/statuses. Clearly MARK /admin/* endpoints as administrative. Optionally include executable curl examples.

APPEND to c:\...\be\README.md (do NOT alter the existing assignment text above): a Setup section (node >=20, npm install), a Run section (the seeded start command npm run dev / npm start and the base URL), a Seed-data note (>=5 products incl. p_limited stock 3; config n=5 x=10, env REWARD_N/REWARD_X), a Test section (npm test), and a link to API.md and DECISIONS.md. Verify the original '#Full-Stack Engineer' assignment content remains intact.

Create c:\...\be\DECISIONS.md covering ALL required items: system invariants (I1 no oversell, I2 at-most-once checkout, I3 single coupon redemption, I4 milestone-once, I5 report reconciliation) with where each is enforced; ambiguities + chosen semantics (price captured at checkout; idempotency fingerprint = cartId|couponCode WITH the explicit assumption that a committed cart is immutable and an Idempotency-Key maps 1:1 to a cart -- F3; coupon reserve-then-commit; milestone forfeiture / latest-milestone-only); at least FIVE material decisions each in Context / Options considered / Choice / Why / Consequences format; the SerialExecutor concurrency + idempotency strategy; money + rounding rules (integer cents, single Math.round half-up, clamp to [0,subtotal]); error-model (AppError + code registry + HTTP status mapping); implemented vs intentionally deferred (per design Section 16); multi-instance + production-DB evolution INCLUDING where reservedBy / a transaction id reappears to scope conditional updates (F4) and the DB UNIQUE(idempotency key) seam; how AI tools were used INCLUDING the concrete correction example -- the design-review loop caught an infeasible concurrency test that assumed an in-task yield barrier would let a second task interleave while the first was parked (it can't: the serial executor blocks the second task), and the test was re-specified around FIFO executor ordering; what you would examine first given another 2 hours; and the approximate time spent (~4-6 hours).
Run the full build and test suite once more to confirm the documentation changes did not break anything and the documented commands actually work.
acceptance_criteria: API.md documents every endpoint with method/path/request/response/status/error cases and marks /admin/* as administrative.
README.md retains its original assignment text verbatim and gains appended Setup/Run/Seed/Test/API sections; the documented seeded start command works.

DECISIONS.md contains every required section, >=5 decisions in Context/Options/Choice/Why/Consequences format, the F3 fingerprint assumption, the F4 reservedBy/txn-id multi-instance note, and the concrete AI-correction example (infeasible in-task-barrier test re-specified around FIFO).
`npm test` and `npm run build` remain green.
verification: Run `npm run build` and `npm test` -- both still green.
Manually confirm (read_file) README.md original assignment text is intact and the appended sections + the documented start command are present.
Manually confirm DECISIONS.md checklist: all required sections, >=5 Context/Options/Choice/Why/Consequences decisions, F3 assumption, F4 note, AI-correction example.
findings: COMPLETED. Created be/API.md (every endpoint: method/path/request/response/status/error cases; /admin/* marked administrative; curl examples), appended Setup/Run/Seed/Test/API sections to be/README.md WITHOUT altering the original assignment text (verified: line 1 still '#Full-Stack Engineer', original closing line intact, appended block starts after a '---' separator), and created be/DECISIONS.md covering all required items: invariants I1-I5 with where enforced, chosen semantics, 7 decisions in Context/Options/Choice/Why/Consequences, SerialExecutor concurrency+idempotency strategy, money/rounding rules, error model, implemented-vs-deferred, multi-instance/production-DB evolution INCLUDING the reservedBy/txn-id reappearance (F4) and the DB UNIQUE(idempotency key) seam, the fingerprint immutable-cart assumption (F3), the concrete AI-correction example (infeasible in-task-yield-barrier test re-specified around FIFO executor ordering), what to examine first in another 2 hours, and ~4-6h time spent. `npm run build` exits 0 and `npm test` = 49 green across 9 files after the doc changes.
